label: Glide ground range in wind is at most h (L/D)max (1 + w/u)
statement_en: A steady glide from height h in an along-track wind w (positive tailwind) covers at most h (L/D)max (1 + w/u) over the ground; a longer claimed ground range is ruled out.

hypotheses.name: see theorem statement
hypotheses.statement: the named hypothesis structure(s) in the theorem statement; instantiated with fetched numbers in Delphi.Perturb.measured

non_vacuity_witness.statement: theorem windGlide_model_witness : ∃ u s h w x LDmax : ℝ, 0 < u ∧ 0 < s ∧ 0 ≤ h ∧ -u ≤ w ∧ u / s ≤ LDmax ∧ x = (u + w) * (h / s)
